In the "Straight Up Farm Crew Characters DLC," you play four unique characters, accompany the Farm Crew, and master the challenges in Straight Up with their diversity. Use rewards, climb the leaderboard, and become the ultimate altitude conqueror with the Farm Crew!

notes.title: Straight Up Tutorial Update
notes.content:
[u][b]Update:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Drops UI has been added
[*] A way point for the end has been added
[/list]

In this update, the tutorial has been improved. Now you can see how many drops need to be collected and how many you have already collected. Furthermore, an additional waypoint has been added so that you know where to go after collecting all the drops.

notes.title: Straight Up is now available
notes.content:
[u]Straight Up is now available[/u]


Welcome to Straight Up, the exciting climbing game where your goal is to reach the top! Choose from three different maps – small, medium, or large – and face the challenge of jumping on objects like cars, crates, and fences to reach the summit.

The real challenge is to not lose patience and composure when you fall back down. Getting back up requires not only skill but also resilience. After reaching the top, grab the Supply Drop for a reward and complete the level. Then return to the lobby, where you can unlock characters and acquire cosmetic upgrades with the earned coins.

The lobby also offers a tutorial, statistics, and the leaderboard. Fulfill tasks to earn additional coins and experience points. Each level reached is crucial to unlocking new characters and cosmetic items.

Immerse yourself in the captivating world of Straight Up, master the art of climbing, and prove that you are the ultimate height conqueror! Rise to the top and become the champion of Straight Up as you collect rewards and showcase your skills. Are you ready for the challenge?

notes.title: The release date has been changed
notes.content:
Exciting news is on the horizon! We are delighted to inform you that the release of "Straight Up" has been moved forward by a few days. Originally scheduled for February 29, 2024, the game will now be available on January 31, 2024!

The earlier release allows us to make the game accessible to you more quickly, as it is already nearly ready. We appreciate your patience and look forward to you diving into the captivating world of "Straight Up" very soon.

So, mark your calendars for January 31, 2024, and get ready to experience this thrilling adventure. We value your support and can't wait for you to enjoy "Straight Up.
